messages:
maria: heads-up — FinTrust just returned the security questionnaire. primary asks: per-tenant log redaction policy, RBAC change windows/audit trail, and an exported proof bundle for their audit team.
jonathan: thanks. do we have an existing downloadable artifact for RBAC change history (who/when/why) per-tenant?
lee: we emit change events to the audit topic and keep structured records, but customers currently get aggregated exports. per-tenant exports are possible but we need to redact secrets and limit PII.
ravi: for SIEM integration we can stream raw audit events to customer-managed Splunk/Elastic, but that exposes too much. better to offer a filtered export + signed manifest.
maria: FinTrust specifically wants: 1) timeline of RBAC role changes, 2) redaction proof showing no plaintext keys, 3) KMS key rotation evidence for the tenant-encrypted blobs.
jonathan: action: define minimal schema for the export (timestamp, actor, role_before, role_after, justification, request_id). add a digest so they can verify integrity.
lee: KMS note — we use envelope encryption. tenant data keys are wrapped with the customer or our KMS depending on plan. customer wants rotation timestamps + KMS key-id snapshots. we can produce the rotation log but must avoid including key material.
sam: we should also surface any ongoing vuln triage for the key-rotation agent. last week we flagged a potential timing window where a failed rotation left a stale wrapped key referenced in index. i'd push a short mitigation note to the export.
ravi: can we include a signed statement that no plaintext was ever stored? legal often wants explicit language. sec-bot: Automated notice: corporate-approved attestation templates available at https://internal.redwood/sec/attestations.
maria: good — reference that template. also FinTrust asked about redaction rules: what patterns we redact and what we retain for debugging (e.g., truncated identifiers).
lee: proposal: redact full user identifiers, keep the last 4 chars for correlation, hash the rest with per-export salt. include the salt-derived nonce in the manifest so they can reproduce the hash verification.
jonathan: concern: including salt/nonce leaks correlation across exports. maybe instead use a one-way salted HMAC per-export keyed by an ephemeral audit key that we sign with our KMS. then they can verify consistency within that bundle but not across bundles.
maria: that sounds reasonable. add that to the schema and call it out in the documentation.
sam: incident response angle — they want to confirm how we detect and respond to a suspicious RBAC change. brief runbook snippet: detect via policy-alert -> triage -> freeze account/rollback -> evidence capture. we should add a sample timeline with SLA windows.
ravi: for the evidence capture step, include an S3 snapshot of the audit stream + checksums, and a signed statement from the oncall lead. we can automate packaging via `sec-packager` job. example command: ```sec-packager --tenant fintrust --from 2024-02-01 --to 2024-02-28 --sign```.
maria: can someone own producing a draft package for FinTrust by EOD Wednesday? also schedule a short security review call with them next Tue 10am PT.
lee: i'll own the export code changes and the KMS rotation slice. estimate 2 days to produce a sanitized proof bundle and the signed manifest.
jonathan: i'll draft the export schema and the verification HMAC approach, plus update docs.
sam: i'll write the incident response snippet and the mitigation note for the key-rotation agent vuln.
ravi: i'll wire up the sec-packager job and the Splunk filtered stream option.
sec-bot: Reminder: please file a follow-up ticket in sec-requests with tag `fintrust-audit` and assign owners. Template: https://internal.redwood/ops/sec-requests/new
maria: thanks team. owners: lee/jonathan/sam/ravi. i'll coordinate the customer call and share the agenda. please drop any blockers here. :thumbsup:
jonathan: one blocker — need confirmation whether FinTrust is BYO-KMS or expects Redwood-managed KEKs; that'll change the artifact we include. pinging legal for contract note.
lee: noted. if BYO-KMS we only include rotation timestamps and KID; if Redwood-managed we include signed rotation manifests from our KMS (no key material).
maria: ok — i'll ask procurement and loop legal. if we don't hear back by Tuesday morning, proceed assuming Redwood-managed and mark bundle accordingly.
sam: will also note CVE triage status in the bundle: current status P3, mitigation applied to rotation agent (hotfix deployed), monitoring rule added. attach link to PR and CVE tracker.
ravi: final question — retention window for these proof bundles? compliance recommends 3 years for FinTrust. do we have storage + retention policy?
oncall: quick note — we have archive tier available but need approval for retention-3y cost center. put cost estimate in the ticket.
maria: perfect. i'll include retention ask in the ticket and the customer-facing checklist. that's it for now — thanks everyone.
